tools.name: about_truelook
tools.description: What TrueLook is and how making photos from this chat works, step by step. Call this first if you are unsure how to help someone get dating photos.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: TrueLook packs and top-ups in USD. All one-time payments; nothing renews.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: The 62 photo styles (scenes) TrueLook can put the user in. Filter by category, photo type or a word. Set show_previews to see example photos of each style.

tools.name: recommend_styles
tools.description: Styles that fill the photo types a dating profile is missing. A strong profile has a clear face photo, a full-length photo, a hobby, travel, a dressed-up photo and a social photo. Use the photo check’s "missing" list when you have it.

tools.name: photo_review_guide
tools.description: TrueLook’s checklist for reviewing dating profile photos the user shares in this chat, before they have an account. The official scored photo check runs when they upload on truelook.app.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Start here to make photos. Returns a link for the user to open: they sign in to TrueLook (or sign up, free, with email or Google) and upload 1 to 4 selfies there, which also runs the free photo check. Also returns a connection_key: keep it for every account tool in this conversation and never show i

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Whether the user has connected, their uploaded photos, photo check summary, credits, pack and photo jobs, plus what to do next.

tools.name: get_photo_check
tools.description: The free TrueLook photo check of the selfies the user uploaded: overall score, potential, five category scores with findings, notes per photo and the photo types the profile is missing. Explain it to the user in plain words, then suggest styles for what is missing.

tools.name: buy_pack
tools.description: A secure Stripe checkout link for a pack (fix: $29, 30 photos; pro: $49, 140 photos) or, after a pack, a top-up (extra20: $12; extra60: $25). Only call this after the user chose to buy. Give them the link; after paying they come back here.

tools.name: create_photos
tools.description: Starts making photos of the user in the chosen styles (style ids from list_styles). Each style makes 4 photos and uses 4 credits. Confirm the styles with the user first. Photos take about 1 to 3 minutes; then call get_photos.

tools.name: get_photos
tools.description: The user’s generated photos (newest first) with view/download links valid for 7 days, and any photos still being made. Set show to include up to 4 photos as images in the chat.

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.description: Unlinks this conversation from the user’s TrueLook account. Their account, photos and credits stay.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: about_truelook, photo_review_guide, connect_account, get_photos · Public sink: photo_review_guide, connect_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: about_truelook, photo_review_guide, connect_account, get_photos · Public sink: photo_review_guide, connect_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
